name: Everest ES8311
summary: Everest ES8311 reusable device protocol/configuration support through declared transport contracts.

evidence.scope: Registered protocol/configuration and simulated bus/backend host cases passed in the 241-case native qualification run on macOS arm64. This does not refresh physical evidence.
Historical ESP32-P4-NANO silicon-v1.0 codec identity, microphone data, digital DMA playback observations; no independent acoustic measurement.

limitations: Bounded 48 kHz, stereo 16-bit Philips I2S startup register sequence with 12.288 MHz MCLK; not a generic codec mode solver.
Board integration owns reset, analog power/amplifier sequencing, clocks and I2S transport. No acoustic accuracy claim.
